description: A React component named DataDisplay that switches between displaying Jira projects and Confluence spaces based on active service selection. Handles connection state and renders appropriate child components or messages.

methods.name: DataDisplay
methods.description: Main React functional component that displays data based on active service and whether the user is connected.
